title: Ghiacciaio: AI measures global ice and water reserves
description: Recent reports highlight the use of artificial intelligence to measure the remaining ice in the world's glaciers and the water hidden within them, according to Italian news sources.

sections.heading: Measuring Global Ice
paragraphs: According to Montagna.TV, efforts are being made to determine how much ice remains in the world's glaciers. The source indicates that artificial intelligence is being employed to attempt to measure this ice volume.

sections.heading: Hidden Water Reserves
paragraphs: Il Messaggero reports that artificial intelligence is being used to reveal the quantity of water hidden in the Earth's glaciers. This application of technology aims to uncover the water resources stored within these ice formations.

sections.heading: Arctic Defense
paragraphs: According to Left - Un pensiero nuovo a sinistra, Antonello Pasini has discussed the application of artificial intelligence in the defense of the Arctic. The report highlights the potential of AI to aid in protecting this region.

faq.q: How is artificial intelligence being used with glaciers?
faq.a: According to Montagna.TV, AI is being used to try to measure how much ice remains in the world's glaciers. Additionally, Il Messaggero reports that AI is revealing how much water is hidden in the Earth's glaciers.

faq.q: Who is discussing AI and the Arctic?
faq.a: According to Left - Un pensiero nuovo a sinistra, Antonello Pasini is discussing the use of artificial intelligence for the defense of the Arctic.
